flows.title: Start an Agent session and generate from it
steps: Select Agent in the left sidebar of your Dashboard, or go to app.runwayml.com/agent, and choose New chat. New timeline opens the timeline editor for footage you already have instead.

Click into the message box at the top of the panel and describe in plain language what you want to start creating. A single simple sentence works well; Agent asks for more detail when it needs it. Typing / in the message box starts an Agent Skill such as Ad Campaign or Mood Board.
Send the first message. Agent analyses the request, builds a plan and may ask questions.
Review the plan and either tell Agent to go ahead or work the concept over with it in the chat first.

Everything made in the session collects in the Generations tab, filterable by asset type or favourited status; a multi-shot video is assembled in the Final Cut tab, where clips can be split, trimmed and rearranged.

flows.title: Split an image into editable layers
steps: From the left navigation bar, click Tool.
Select the Image tab at the top of the generation panel.
Click the model dropdown at the bottom of the panel and find Seedream 5.0 Layers.
Upload the image to split. A prompt is optional — add one to control how the layers are split or to isolate a smaller element, describing the elements you want separated.
Generate. The layer editor opens in the session, where each layer can be selected, hidden, reordered, moved, resized or rotated, and the result downloaded or exported for another editor.
